integrity: Proof gives summable lower and upper tails; numerical checks corroborate only finite cases. Analytic arguments and source comparisons received self-review; no independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed iid within-table probability p in (0,1), polynomially growing rectangular sides, only leading squared-logarithm asymptotics. Unknown fluctuations and variable p; possible unindexed equivalents in random bipartite graph literature.
title: Almost-sure logarithmic concept-count law for rectangular Bernoulli contexts
